description:
Brand Introduction

Made & True specializes in high-quality wedding and event signage. Our mission is to enhance special occasions with unique, customizable designs that reflect the personal style of our customers. From elegant to whimsical, our signage elevates the ambiance of any event, ensuring memorable experiences.

Product Description

We offer a diverse range of signage options, including:

  • Welcome Signs: Customizable designs that greet guests with warmth and style.
  • Directional Signs: Help guests navigate your event with charm and clarity.
  • Table Signs: Beautifully crafted pieces that enhance table settings.
  • Custom Designs: Tailored signage options to perfectly fit any theme or vision.

All our products are made with high-quality acrylic or stone materials, ensuring durability and aesthetic appeal, making them perfect for weddings, parties, and corporate events.

Unique Selling Point (USP)

What sets Made & True apart is our focus on customization and quality. We provide unique designs that can be personalized to suit any event, ensuring that each piece not only complements the occasion but also resonates with the client’s personal taste. Our commitment to craftsmanship and customer satisfaction guarantees that every sign will exceed expectations.

Payment Terms

  • Commission Rate: Affiliates earn a commission of 10% on each sale generated through their referral links.
  • Cookie Duration: A 60-day cookie period allows affiliates to earn commissions on sales made by referred customers within that timeframe.
  • Payout Threshold: No payout threshold! 
  • Payment Schedule: Commissions will be paid out monthly via Paypal & all payments issued on the 1st of every month.

Other Information

  • Support: Affiliates will receive ongoing support via email.
  • Communication: Regular updates will be sent to affiliates about new products, seasonal promotions, and other opportunities to boost sales.
  • Community: Affiliates will have access to a community forum or group for networking and sharing strategies.

Made & True Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

1. Introduction Welcome to the Made & True Affiliate Program! By participating, you agree to abide by these terms and conditions. Please read them carefully to ensure a successful partnership.

2. Eligibility To qualify for our affiliate program, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years old.
  • Have a valid website, blog, or social media platform that reflects the professionalism and values of Made & True.
  • Reside in Wisconsin or comply with our shipping policies.

3. Application Process

  • Interested individuals must complete the online application form.
  • Made & True reserves the right to accept or reject any application based on alignment with our brand and standards.

4. Affiliate Links and Promotion

  • Upon approval, you will receive unique affiliate links to promote Made & True products.
  • Affiliates are prohibited from modifying or disguising these links.
  • Promotion must align with our brand image and must be done ethically and professionally.

5. Commissions

  • Affiliates will earn a commission of 10% on sales generated through their unique links.
  • Commissions will be paid monthly via Paypal & issued on the 1st of every month. 
  • No commissions will be paid on returned or canceled orders.
  • Excludes shipping & sales tax

6. Marketing Guidelines

  • Affiliates must promote Made & True products honestly and transparently.
  • Spamming, unsolicited email marketing, and any form of misleading advertising are strictly prohibited.
  • All marketing efforts must comply with FTC guidelines regarding affiliate disclosures.

7. Intellectual Property

  • Affiliates are granted a limited, non-exclusive license to use Made & True’s trademarks and promotional materials solely for the affiliate program.
  • All rights to intellectual property remain with Made & True.

8. Termination

  • Either party may terminate this agreement at any time, with or without cause, by providing written notice.
  • Upon termination, affiliates must cease all use of Made & True trademarks and affiliate links.

9. Limitation of Liability

  • Made & True shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from participation in the affiliate program.

10. Modifications

  • Made & True reserves the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Changes will be communicated via email or updated on our website.

11. Governing Law

  • These terms and conditions are governed by the laws of the State of Wisconsin.

12. Contact Information For any inquiries regarding the affiliate program, please contact us at hello@madeandtrue.com
